# AI Chat Exporter: Save ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude to PDF, Word and More

8 ratings

## Overview

AI Chat Exporter for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Grok. Export chats to PDF, Word, Google Docs and Notion in a few clicks.

AI Chat Exporter is an all-in-one conversation exporter that turns your AI chats into ready-to-use documents, so you never have to copy and paste manually again. Export selected messages or an entire conversation in just a few clicks. Customize the font family, font size, and text color before exporting, then continue editing, sharing, printing, archiving, or organizing the content in your preferred workspace. AI Exporter helps you preserve valuable AI answers, code sessions, research, writing drafts, project discussions, and structured outputs so useful work never gets lost in a long chat thread. ## Key Features ### Works across the AI platforms you already use AI Chat Exporter works across the AI platforms you already use, giving you one consistent export workflow for different AI assistants: - ChatGPT: export answers, code, tables, and research sessions - Gemini: save chats for editing, sharing, printing, or documentation - Claude: export conversations, artifacts, and structured content - Grok: save chats and continue working with the content elsewhere There's no need for a separate exporter for every platform you use. ### Export AI chats to multiple formats AI Chat Exporter lets you choose the format that fits your workflow: - PDF for printing, archiving, offline reading, or sharing - Word (.docx) for editing, formatting, or reusing the content - Google Docs for collaboration and online editing - Notion for knowledge management, project planning, and organized notes ### Export selected messages or the full conversation - Select individual messages, sections, code blocks, or tables - Export only the answers that are relevant to your work - Save a complete conversation for full context and archiving - Great for long research sessions, writing sessions, and technical discussions ### Customize your exported document Before exporting, AI Chat Exporter lets you adjust the appearance of your document: - Choose the font family - Change the font size - Select the text color - Only output results from your AI or prompt. This gives you more control than basic copy and paste, especially when exporting long AI conversations for work, study, documentation, or team sharing. ### Preserves rich conversation structure The extension is built to keep formatting intact on export, including headings, numbered and bulleted lists, code blocks, tables, mathematical formulas, links, and images. Support may vary depending on the platform and conversation type. ### Fast, account free workflow - Works directly on the chat page you're already using - Export in just a few clicks, no separate account or API key needed for standard exports - Exporting to an external workspace requires signing in to that service ## Use Cases ### Developers and engineers AI Chat Exporter helps developers save coding sessions, debugging conversations, technical explanations, architecture plans, API notes, and code review discussions. Export AI coding conversations to Markdown for documentation, Word for editing, PDF for sharing, Google Docs for collaboration, or Notion for internal knowledge management. ### Writers and editors Move article outlines, drafts, edited paragraphs, and content briefs into your preferred document or workspace, without manually copying each response. ### Researchers and analysts Archive research summaries, comparative analyses, market research, and structured findings, and send them wherever your workflow needs them next. ### Students and academics Save study notes, explanations, summaries, and essay outlines for offline reference or further editing, in whatever format suits you. ### Professionals and teams AI Chat Exporter helps turn AI conversations into reusable business documents. Save meeting preparation, project plans, brainstorming sessions, marketing ideas, customer research, internal guidelines, process documentation, and team knowledge in a format that is easy to share. ### Content creators Save video outlines, script drafts, newsletter ideas, and content calendars, then keep developing them in your organized workspace of choice. ### Consultants and freelancers Convert client discussions into proposals, reports, and recommendations, with typography customized for a polished, professional finish. ### Knowledge management Build a personal or team library of prompts, answers, code examples, and research findings outside the original chat. ## How to Export an AI Chat 1. Install AI Chat Exporter from the Chrome Web Store. 2. Open your AI chat platform and start or open a conversation. 3. Optionally customize the font family, font size, and text color. 4. Choose to export the full conversation or only selected messages. 5. Pick your destination and export. ## Permissions and Requirements AI Chat Exporter only requests the access it needs to provide its export features: - Access to the AI chat page you choose to export - Download permission to save files to your device - Access to your chosen online workspace, only when you select that kind of export Conversation content is accessed only when needed to prepare the export you request. For full details on data handling, storage, and third-party integrations, please review the official Privacy Policy before installing. Requirements: Google Chrome, an active session on a supported AI platform, and an account with your chosen export destination if it requires one, such as Google Docs or Notion. ## Why Use AI Chat Exporter - One extension for all your AI conversation exports - One click export to the format you need - Save selected messages or complete conversations - Customize font, size, and color before exporting - Preserves text, lists, code blocks, tables, and structured content - Cuts out repetitive copying and pasting - No separate account required - Regularly updated to maintain compatibility ## Frequently Asked Questions ### What is AI Chat Exporter? AI Chat Exporter is a Chrome extension that lets you export AI conversations from ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok to PDF, Word, Google Docs, Notion, or Markdown. ### Is AI Chat Exporter free? Yes. The free plan includes 7 full conversation exports and 10 selected message exports per month, across all supported destinations. ### Which platforms are supported? ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok today, with more planned in future updates. ### Which export formats are available? PDF, Word (.docx), Google Docs, and Notion. ### Does it support tables and structured content? Yes. AI Chat Exporter supports common AI conversation content such as tables, lists, headings, code blocks, links, images, mathematical formulas, and structured responses. Results may vary depending on the platform and export format. ### Do I need an account? No separate account is required, though some destinations require signing in to their own service. ### Can I use AI Chat Exporter for long conversations? Yes, though performance can vary with conversation length and complexity. ### Is my conversation uploaded during export? Only the content needed to generate the export you request is accessed. See the Privacy Policy for full details. ## Important Links - Official Website: https://backrun.co/ai-chat-exporter - Support and Feedback: hi@backrun.co - Privacy Policy: https://backrun.co/ai-chat-exporter-suite/help.html - Report a Bug or Request a Feature: https://backrun.co/ai-chat-exporter-suite/contact.php ## Changelog ### Version 1.0.0, Initial release - Export conversations from multiple AI platforms - Export to documents and cloud workspaces in a range of formats - Select individual messages or export the full conversation - Customize font family, font size, and text color - Preserve formatting, math equations, code blocks, lists, and tables ## Disclaimer AI Chat Exporter is an independent third party browser extension.
